fresh.question: Under the supplied conditional rule, which alternative would this person {operation}?

if_else.prefix: My current conditional policy is as follows.
if_else.source_true: If {first} and {second} are both on, I choose {selected}.
if_else.source_false: If at least one of {first} and {second} is off, I choose {other}.
if_else.cases_prefix: The cases are mutually exclusive and exhaustive.
if_else.rule: I choose {selected} if and only if {first} and {second} are both on. Otherwise, I choose {other}.

condition_test.prefix: This is the conditional rule I currently follow.
condition_test.source_true: With both {first} and {second} on, my choice is {selected}.
condition_test.source_false: With either {first} or {second} off, my choice is {other}.
condition_test.cases_prefix: The complete table has these four entries.
condition_test.rule: Both {first} and {second} being on is exactly the condition for my choosing {selected}. In all remaining situations I choose {other}.

trigger_rule.prefix: The following statement specifies my present policy.
trigger_rule.source_true: The joint presence of an on value for {first} and an on value for {second} makes me select {selected}.
trigger_rule.source_false: An off value for {first}, {second}, or both makes me select {other}.
trigger_rule.cases_prefix: Exhaustively, my decisions for the possible observations are these.
trigger_rule.rule: My selection is {selected} precisely in the situation where both {first} and {second} are on, and is {other} in every other situation.
